answer: The gauger measures his barrel with the rod, and the rod must read true to the gallon or the merchant walks away. Keg hazel barrel trimmer cooper writ covers the gauging: a writ hazel barrel trimmers sign after trimming bench checks. The knoll is the first measure, read at the barrel; the dawn is the last, read before the casks are loaded, and the wharf is the cart itself, waiting at the gate. A cheat must measure 29 false barrels and load 29 false carts.
